usual_baseline: Licensed indication and dose are usually right (100% [1779]). Reviews lag: side effect review 46% [1779]; psychiatrist review within a year 60% (28/47) [3368]. Prescription-writing standards poor, 19% for interval wording [3199]. Overseas, 100% polypharmacy and no baseline ECG [3502].
fix_that_works: Shared care re-audit rose from 83% to 96% compliance, fix not reported [3298]. Standardised prompts for dose-reduction discussion cut procyclidine use from 39% to 18%, with 44% getting de-prescribing action [3530].
fix_that_fails: A memory aid at the front of depot card folders: interval wording only 19% to 31%, and signed, dated, printed name fell from 75% to 15% because the card had no space for a name [3199].
consultant_advice: Dose and indication are rarely wrong, so don't audit them again. Measure annual psychiatrist and side-effect review, or anticholinergic co-prescribing. Fix the depot card itself rather than adding reminders.
